inventory.title: Pieces
inventory.ownHint: {count} pieces in total. The track will fit within these.
inventory.skipHint: Piece counts are unlimited, and the result is a shopping list.
inventory.presetHint: Generic size classes, not the contents of any particular set.
inventory.flexHint: Your own bendable piece, which absorbs the closing error.
inventory.flexSkipHint: Not available in shopping list mode: the list may only contain pieces you can buy.

generate.blank: Empty floor. Draw a track with one finger, or generate one.

failure.unknown: No track was found with these settings.
failure.area-too-small: The area is too small for a track. Try a larger area.
failure.no-corner-elements-affordable: Not enough curves for a single corner. Add curves or try shopping list mode.
failure.inventory-or-placement-failed: Not enough pieces. Add pieces or shrink the area.
failure.closure-beyond-budget: The track falls {shortfall} mm short and does not close. Try another seed or enable the flex piece.
failure.joint-over-safety-cap: One joint would be too sharp. Try another seed.
failure.self-collision: The track would run into itself. Try a larger area or another seed.
failure.outside-area: The track does not fit the area. Try a larger area.

draw.hint: Draw the track with one finger. Two fingers cancel and navigate.
draw.fitted: Drawn track: {pieces} pieces · {length} m · off by {deviation} mm

failure.unknown: The stroke did not turn into a track.
failure.drawing-too-short: The stroke is too short for a track. Draw a longer one.
failure.no-fit: No combination of pieces follows that stroke. Try a gentler shape.
failure.closure-beyond-budget: The loop does not close. Draw a rounder loop or enable the flex piece.
failure.joint-over-safety-cap: One joint would be too sharp. Draw a gentler shape.
failure.self-collision: The track would run into itself. A crossing can be resolved as a branch: draw the track without crossing first, then add the crossing part as a branch.

branch.choose: Pick a branch on the map.

failure.unknown: The branch could not be added.
failure.drawing-too-short: That stroke is too short for a branch. Draw a longer one.
failure.not-on-track: The branch starts too far from the track. Start the stroke next to it.
failure.no-branch-point: No spot near here takes a switch. Try another place along the track, or add switches to your pieces.
failure.no-fit: No combination of pieces follows that branch. Try a gentler shape.
failure.ends-beyond-budget: The switch does not fit on this run. Try another spot.
failure.joint-over-safety-cap: One joint would end up too sharp. Draw a gentler shape.
failure.self-collision: The branch would hit the rest of the track. Draw it on the other side.
failure.crossing-unresolved: The branch crosses the track where neither a crossing nor a bridge fits, and it has no room to stop short either. Cross the track head-on and leave straight track on both sides of the crossing.

section.brief: {length} cm · {pieces} pieces · clearance {left} cm left, {right} cm right
section.drawHint: Draw a new shape for the section. Both ends stay where they are.
section.notReplaceable: This section cannot be replaced by drawing.
section.replaced: Section replaced: {pieces} pieces · track {length} m · off by {deviation} mm

failure.unknown: The section could not be replaced.
failure.section-not-replaceable: This section cannot be replaced: a branch leaves from its middle, or it covers the whole track.
failure.drawing-too-short: The stroke is too short. Draw from one end of the section to the other.
failure.no-fit: No combination of pieces follows that stroke and still ends at the section's end port. Try a gentler shape.
failure.ends-beyond-budget: The shape does not reach the end ports. Try a gentler shape, or stretch the selection with the handles.
failure.joint-over-safety-cap: One joint would be too sharp. Draw a gentler shape.
failure.self-collision: The new run would hit the rest of the track. Draw it on the other side.
failure.no-options: No options were found for this run. Stretch the selection with the handles, or add pieces.
failure.no-room: There is no clearance on either side of the track, and nearly every ready-made pattern needs some. Pick a run with room beside it, or enlarge the area.

gap.open: Gap of {length} cm. Leave it open, fill it, draw instead, or undo.

failure.unknown: The gap could not be filled.
failure.section-not-removable: This section cannot be deleted: a branch leaves from its middle, or it covers the whole track.
failure.no-fill: The gap cannot be filled with straights: its ends are not on the same line. Draw instead.
failure.ends-beyond-budget: The filling does not reach the end ports. Stretch the selection with the handles.
failure.joint-over-safety-cap: One joint would be too sharp.
failure.self-collision: The filling would hit the rest of the track.

edit.choose: Pick an option on the map.

share.too-long: The track is too large to share as a link.
share.drawn: A drawn track cannot be shared as a link yet — the link would only reproduce the generated track.
